question: Will the 12-month change in U.S. core CPI (CPI-U less food and energy, seasonally adjusted; computed from the index) for February 2025 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2025-02-14) be at least 3.10% and below 3.30%?

rule.threshold_basis: rounded lower and upper quartiles of historical moves over the same distance

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
